meta_note: All methods are exposed as gRPC procedures on the AiService package. Auth context is passed via gRPC Metadata decoded by RpcAuthGuard into metadata.user via @RpcUser().

conventions.auth: RpcAuthGuard — reads the JWT from gRPC metadata, validates it, and exposes the decoded user via @RpcUser(). All methods require a valid access token.

rpc_errors.OUT_OF_RANGE: Model returned truncated or null output — classification result could not be parsed

classifyTransactions.description: Classify a batch of unclassified Mono bank transactions against the user's categories using a two-phase pipeline: (1) pgvector cosine-distance similarity search against prior user corrections, and (2) AI classification via gemini-2.5-flash with structured output. Short-circuits with an empty classifications array when the transaction list is empty.

input.categories: array of { id: string, slug: string, name: string, tags: string[] } — the user's full category list
input.transactions: array of { id: string, narration: string, category: string } — Mono transactions to classify; category is the raw Mono enum hint (may be empty)

output.classifications: array of { transactionId: string, categoryId: string, categorySlug: string } — one entry per input transaction

throws.OUT_OF_RANGE: Model returned truncated or null output
